cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Interpret the Custom
cards.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Our gardening club supports members 'where possible.' Will you sign my appeal against losing my allotment?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That could just mean wishing you luck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. You get to interpret it. I'd like to know whether membership reaches as far as your signature.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Some members want my name kept off it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the same words have to cover me and their disapproval. Whose comfort does 'possible' protect?

mechanism: A corrects a club member's weak reading of possible support, pressing them to reveal through a signature whose loyalty the custom protects.
confusable: A plain demand for support lacks D179's ambiguous wording as the test; S03 must interpret terms in response to B.
comparison: Peer pressure in an appeal differs from meal allocation within a family.
seedUse: Keep where-possible wording, good-wishes alternative and other members' resistance; ground final test in an actual signing choice.
